title: Bumper: DEVELOPING
mood: news alert, not alarm: a ticker, the motif head, left open (Dsus4)
description: Segment bumper for DEVELOPING, built from Zoo's motif (3.4 s).
usage: Cut on the downbeat at the segment change: the file starts with two frames of silence, so start it at downbeatStartFrame(cue, cutFrame) (2 frames early). The music is finished before the file ends. -16 LUFS-I.
selfReview: A news alert, not an alarm: three beats of rising 16th ticker (pulse and hats) under a tremolo swell; the motif head then lands on Dsus4(add9) and stays open. Critic round 1 (2026-11-24): the piano left the ticker (one Kawai sample per note repeated twelve times read as a machine gun) and the brass is 3 dB lower. No sirens, no risers to white noise. Critic round 2 (2026-11-24): release-ready; re-rendered with the shared fixes (measured tuning, the decaying FingerBass, one kick tuning, the band compressors, the -1.5 dBTP sting ceiling). Master limiter 1.64 dB at most; -2.2 dBTP after AAC 128k (worst of ten), -1.4 dBTP after Opus 128k.
